facts.fact: The Bank of Ghana's press release states that it and the National Bank of Rwanda signed a memorandum of understanding on 25 February 2025 at the Inclusive Fintech Forum in Rwanda to introduce a licence passporting framework and cross-border payment interoperability for regulated fintechs licensed by either central bank.

systems.owner: Bank of Ghana; National Bank of Rwanda
systems.tiers: regulated fintechs licensed by either central bank
